name: 帧间伪造检测
description: 检测视频序列中的帧插入、删除和复制攻击。
useCase: Identifying temporal 篡改 through inter-frame relationship 分析
mechanism: 分析 inter-frame 相关性 模式, motion vectors, and prediction residuals 以检测 frame-level 篡改. Frame insertion/deletion disrupts the natural 相关性 sequence, while frame duplication creates detectable repetition 模式 in the motion field.
source: Wu, Y. et al. (2014) - Exposing Video Inter-Frame Forgery by Zernike Opponent Chromaticity Moments. Multimedia Systems
algorithm: Inter-Frame Correlation + Motion Vector Analysis + Prediction Residual Anomaly Detection
parameters: Correlation: Pearson/SSIM, Motion vectors: block matching, Residual 阈值: 自适应, Window: entire video
